title: A wrong password, the client's own retry, then a good login to the character selection screen
notes: Every step waits on a line of the server's log, a line of the client's log, a reference crop of the
window or a row of the scratch database, and nothing waits a fixed time.
{user}, {password} and {wrongpassword} are the account the run creates for itself.
The run ends with the client admitted, so it is asked to quit; a client still refused a login is ended
instead, because asking that one to quit opens a page of KingsIsle's in the machine's own browser.

steps.name: the client brings its renderer up
the login window is on the screen
the login window
submit a wrong password
the client sends its authentication request
the server reads the authentication message
the server refuses the wrong password
steps.pattern: failed to authenticate as {user}: the password is wrong; sent MSG_USER_AUTHEN_RSP Error=(\S+)

steps.name: the client is told the login failed
the client shows its own invalid-login message box
the invalid-login dialog is on the screen
the invalid-login dialog
press the button that reconnects
the server sees that session close
the login window is back
the login window after reconnecting
submit the right password
the client sends its authentication request again
the server accepts the password
the client is told the login succeeded
the client is admitted
steps.pattern: The LoginServer has admitted the user

steps.name: the server reads the character list request
the server answers with an empty character list
the scratch database holds no wizard
the client reads the character list
the character selection scene loads
steps.pattern: WizardCharacterSelect: The scene has been loaded successfully\.

steps.name: the character selection screen is on the screen
the character selection screen
the session stays up through a keepalive
nothing the server sent confused the client
steps.pattern: Received an unknown message type|Received invalid message service|Unknown message type
